title: Disaster Hazard Heatmap, Civic Incident & Safe Shelter Router
name: Disaster Hazard Heatmap, Civic Incident & Safe Shelter Router
user_prompt: Develop a civic flood/storm hazard monitor, citizen incident reporter, and emergency shelter routing portal centered in Miami. Render an interactive Google Map displaying a high-density deck.gl HeatmapLayer (via GoogleMapsOverlay) of reported storm/flooding incidents alongside active flood-hazard zone polygons. Allow residents to click the map to log a geotagged civic hazard report enriched automatically with reverse-geocoded street address (Geocoding API), terrain elevation (Elevation API), and live wind/precipitation conditions (Weather API). Include a 'Find Safe Shelter' feature that searches nearby hospitals or community centers via Places API (New) and calculates an evacuation route via the Routes API configured to avoid the active flood-hazard polygon.

Clicking the map populates a civic incident report with reverse-geocoded address, elevation, and live weather
Nearby emergency shelters/hospitals are fetched and displayed with Advanced Markers
Evacuation route polyline avoiding the hazard polygon is calculated and drawn on the map
